source.post_text:
🚨 Manchester City have made contact with Alexis Mac Allister’s representatives to explore a potential move for the Liverpool midfielder.

Mac Allister is on City’s shortlist of midfield targets should Rodri leave the Etihad this summer.

(Source: @MattThielen)

replies.text: Why does this account spread so much fake news?
replies.author: @NathanLeeUK

replies.text:
£250m transfer fee, if he wants a move to another PL club. (Which I doubt)

Shouldn't be selling a good player to a rival.

replies.text: Hard to see Liverpool letting him go to City even if Rodri exits, though the fit under Pep could work if the fee was ridiculous.
